question.en: Identify the tense in the sentence: 'She goes to school every day.'
question.hi: वाक्य में काल पहचानिए: 'She goes to school every day.'

explanation.en: The sentence expresses a habitual action using the base verb with 's/es' (goes), which is the standard structure of the Simple Present Tense.
explanation.hi: यह वाक्य मुख्य क्रिया के साथ 's/es' (goes) का उपयोग करके एक आदत संबंधी कार्य को व्यक्त करता है, जो सामान्य वर्तमान काल की मानक संरचना है।

question.en: Choose the correct past form of the verb 'write'.
question.hi: 'write' क्रिया का सही भूतकाल रूप चुनें।

explanation.en: The past form (V2) of 'write' is 'wrote'. 'Written' is the past participle (V3).
explanation.hi: 'write' का भूतकाल रूप (V2) 'wrote' है। 'Written' भूत कृदंत (V3) है।

question.en: Which auxiliary verb is used with 'he/she/it' in the Simple Present Tense for negative sentences?
question.hi: साधारण वर्तमान काल में नकारात्मक वाक्यों के लिए 'he/she/it' के साथ किस सहायक क्रिया का उपयोग किया जाता है?

explanation.en: In the Simple Present Tense, singular third-person pronouns (he, she, it) take 'does' along with 'not' for negative sentences.
explanation.hi: साधारण वर्तमान काल में, एकवचन तृतीय-पुरुष सर्वनाम (he, she, it) नकारात्मक वाक्यों के लिए 'not' के साथ 'does' का उपयोग करते हैं।

question.en: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the verb: 'They _____ playing cricket now.'
question.hi: क्रिया के सही रूप से रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'They _____ playing cricket now.'

explanation.en: The subject 'They' is plural and the word 'now' indicates the present continuous tense, so the auxiliary verb 'are' is correct.
explanation.hi: कर्ता 'They' बहुवचन है और शब्द 'now' वर्तमान निरंतर काल का संकेत देता है, इसलिए सहायक क्रिया 'are' सही है।

question.en: What is the future tense form of: 'I eat an apple.'?
question.hi: 'I eat an apple.' का भविष्य काल रूप क्या है?

explanation.en: To form the Simple Future Tense, we use 'shall' or 'will' followed by the base form of the verb (eat).
explanation.hi: सामान्य भविष्य काल बनाने के लिए, हम क्रिया के मूल रूप (eat) के साथ 'shall' या 'will' का उपयोग करते हैं।

question.en: Identify the sentence written in the Present Perfect Tense.
question.hi: पूर्ण वर्तमान काल में लिखे गए वाक्य को पहचानिए।

explanation.en: Present Perfect Tense uses 'has/have' + past participle (V3). 'He has finished' fits this rule.
explanation.hi: पूर्ण वर्तमान काल में 'has/have' + भूत कृदंत (V3) का उपयोग होता है। 'He has finished' इस नियम पर खरा उतरता है।

question.en: Which of the following is the V3 (Past Participle) form of 'go'?
question.hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा 'go' का V3 (Past Participle) रूप है?

explanation.en: The forms of 'go' are: go (V1), went (V2), gone (V3). Thus, 'gone' is the V3 form.
explanation.hi: 'go' के रूप हैं: go (V1), went (V2), gone (V3)। अतः 'gone' V3 रूप है।

question.en: Choose the correct past continuous form: 'The boy _____ a kite.'
question.hi: सही भूत निरंतर रूप चुनें: 'The boy _____ a kite.'

explanation.en: For a singular subject ('The boy') in the past continuous tense, we use 'was' + V1-ing ('was flying').
explanation.hi: भूत निरंतर काल में एकवचन कर्ता ('The boy') के लिए, हम 'was' + V1-ing ('was flying') का उपयोग करते हैं।

question.en: Identify the tense of: 'The sun rises in the east.'
question.hi: 'The sun rises in the east.' का काल पहचानिए।

explanation.en: Universal truths and permanent facts are always expressed in the Simple Present Tense.
explanation.hi: सार्वभौमिक सत्यों और स्थायी तथ्यों को हमेशा सामान्य वर्तमान काल में व्यक्त किया जाता है।

question.en: What is the past form of the modal auxiliary 'can'?
question.hi: सहायक क्रिया (Modal) 'can' का भूतकाल रूप क्या है?

explanation.en: The past tense form of the modal verb 'can' is 'could'.
explanation.hi: मॉडल क्रिया 'can' का भूतकाल रूप 'could' है।

question.en: Fill in the blank with the correct tense: 'By next month, we _____ this project.'
question.hi: सही काल के साथ रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'By next month, we _____ this project.'

explanation.en: Expressions starting with 'By next month/year' indicating an action completed before a point in the future require the Future Perfect Tense ('will have' + V3).
explanation.hi: 'By next month/year' से शुरू होने वाले выражения जो भविष्य में किसी बिंदु से पहले पूरे होने वाले कार्य को दर्शाते हैं, उनके लिए Future Perfect Tense ('will have' + V3) की आवश्यकता होती है।

question.en: Choose the correct option to fill in the blank: 'He _____ as a teacher for ten years before he moved to administration.'
question.hi: रिक्त स्थान भरने के लिए सही विकल्प चुनें: 'He _____ as a teacher for ten years before he moved to administration.'

explanation.en: When two actions happened in the past, the earlier action is expressed in the Past Perfect Tense ('had worked') and the later action in Simple Past ('moved').
explanation.hi: जब भूतकाल में दो घटनाएँ घटित होती हैं, तो पहली घटना को Past Perfect Tense ('had worked') में और बाद वाली घटना को Simple Past ('moved') में व्यक्त किया जाता है।

question.en: Identify the correct sentence using the Present Perfect Continuous Tense.
question.hi: Present Perfect Continuous Tense का उपयोग करने वाले सही वाक्य को पहचानिए।

text.en: It has been raining since morning.
text.hi: It has been raining since morning.

explanation.en: Presence of 'since' or 'for' with a time reference indicating ongoing action requires 'has/have been' + V1-ing. Thus, 'It has been raining since morning' is correct.
explanation.hi: समय संदर्भ के साथ 'since' या 'for' की उपस्थिति जो निरंतर जारी कार्य को दर्शाती है, के लिए 'has/have been' + V1-ing की आवश्यकता होती है। अतः 'It has been raining since morning' सही है।

question.en: Choose the correct form of the verb: 'Hardly had I stepped out of the house _____ it started raining.'
question.hi: क्रिया का सही रूप चुनें: 'Hardly had I stepped out of the house _____ it started raining.'

explanation.en: The correlative conjunction pairing for 'Hardly' or 'Scarcely' is always 'when' (or 'before'), whereas 'No sooner' is followed by 'than'.
explanation.hi: 'Hardly' या 'Scarcely' के साथ हमेशा 'when' (या 'before') का जोड़ा बनता है, जबकि 'No sooner' के बाद 'than' आता है।

question.en: Select the sentence that is grammatically correct.
question.hi: व्याकरण की दृष्टि से सही वाक्य का चयन करें।

text.en: I know him since two years.
text.hi: I know him since two years.

text.en: I have known him for two years.
text.hi: I have known him for two years.

text.en: I am knowing him for two years.
text.hi: I am knowing him for two years.

text.en: I knew him for two years.
text.hi: I knew him for two years.

explanation.en: 'Know' is a stative verb and is not normally used in continuous tenses. With 'for' denoting duration up to the present, Present Perfect Tense ('have known') is required. Also, 'for' is used for a period of time, not 'since'.
explanation.hi: 'Know' एक स्थितिबोधक (stative verb) क्रिया है और सामान्यतः निरंतर काल में उपयोग नहीं की जाती। वर्तमान तक की अवधि दर्शाने वाले 'for' के साथ, Present Perfect Tense ('have known') का उपयोग होता है।

question.en: Fill in the blank: 'If you work hard, you _____ pass the exam.'
question.hi: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'If you work hard, you _____ pass the exam.'

explanation.en: In a First Conditional sentence, the 'if' clause is in the Simple Present ('work'), and the main clause takes 'will' + base verb ('will pass').
explanation.hi: प्रथम शतकीय (First Conditional) वाक्य में, 'if' उपवाक्य Simple Present ('work') में होता है, और मुख्य उपवाक्य में 'will' + मूल क्रिया ('will pass') का प्रयोग होता है।

question.en: Choose the appropriate tense form: 'Look! The train _____.'
question.hi: उपयुक्त काल रूप चुनें: 'Look! The train _____.'

explanation.en: Interjections or exclamation indicators like 'Look!', 'Listen!', or 'Hark!' generally demand the Present Continuous Tense to show an action happening right at the moment of speaking.
explanation.hi: 'Look!', 'Listen!', या 'Hark!' जैसे विस्मयादिबोधक संकेत बोलने के समय हो रही क्रिया को दिखाने के लिए आमतौर पर Present Continuous Tense की मांग करते हैं।

question.en: Identify the correct indirect narration tense shift rule for: Direct: He said, 'I am writing a letter.'
question.hi: डायरेक्ट से इनडायरेक्ट बनाते समय काल परिवर्तन नियम पहचानिए: Direct: He said, 'I am writing a letter.'

text.en: He said that he is writing a letter.
text.hi: He said that he is writing a letter.

text.en: He said that he was writing a letter.
text.hi: He said that he was writing a letter.

text.en: He said that he has written a letter.
text.hi: He said that he has written a letter.

text.en: He said that he had written a letter.
text.hi: He said that he had written a letter.

explanation.en: When the reporting verb is in the past tense ('said'), the Present Continuous tense ('am writing') changes correspondingly to the Past Continuous tense ('was writing').
explanation.hi: जब रिपोर्टिंग वर्ब भूतकाल में हो ('said'), तो Present Continuous tense ('am writing') बदलकर Past Continuous tense ('was writing') हो जाता है।

question.en: Choose the correct verb form: 'It is high time we _____ our decision.'
question.hi: क्रिया का सही रूप चुनें: 'It is high time we _____ our decision.'

explanation.en: Phrases like 'It is time', 'It is high time', or 'It is about time' followed by a subject must take the Simple Past Tense (V2) to express that something should have been done already.
explanation.hi: 'It is time', 'It is high time', या 'It is about time' के बाद यदि कोई कर्ता आता है, तो यह दर्शाने के लिए कि कार्य पहले ही हो जाना चाहिए था, Simple Past Tense (V2) का प्रयोग होता है।

question.en: Select the correct sentence depicting future continuous tense.
question.hi: Future continuous tense को दर्शाने वाले सही वाक्य का चयन करें।

text.en: She will have been cooking food.
text.hi: She will have been cooking food.

explanation.en: Future Continuous Tense is structured using 'will be / shall be' + present participle (V1-ing). Thus, 'She will be cooking food' is correct.
explanation.hi: Future Continuous Tense की संरचना 'will be / shall be' + present participle (V1-ing) से होती है। अतः 'She will be cooking food' सही है।

question.en: Choose the correct combination of verbs to complete the sentence: 'When the police _____, the thieves _____ away.'
question.hi: वाक्य को पूरा करने के लिए क्रियाओं का सही संयोजन चुनें: 'When the police _____, the thieves _____ away.'

explanation.en: Between two past actions, the action that took place first (thieves running away) is expressed in the Past Perfect Tense ('had run'), and the subsequent action (police arriving) is in the Simple Past ('arrived').
explanation.hi: भूतकाल की दो घटनाओं में से जो घटना पहले हुई (चोरों का भागना), उसे Past Perfect Tense ('had run') में तथा बाद की घटना (पुलिस का पहुँचना) को Simple Past ('arrived') में व्यक्त किया जाता है।

question.en: Identify the error or choose the correct option: 'I wish I _____ a king.'
question.hi: त्रुटि पहचानें या सही विकल्प चुनें: 'I wish I _____ a king.'

explanation.en: In subjunctive mood sentences expressing an unreal wish or hypothetical condition, 'were' is used with all subjects, even singular ones like 'I'.
explanation.hi: अवास्तविक इच्छा या काल्पनिक स्थिति को व्यक्त करने वाले आत्मपरक (subjunctive) वाक्यों में, 'I' जैसे एकवचन कर्ता के साथ भी 'were' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

question.en: Fill in the blank with the correct conditional verb form: 'If he had invited me, I _____ attended the function.'
question.hi: सही कंडीशनल क्रिया रूप से रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'If he had invited me, I _____ attended the function.'

explanation.en: In a Third Conditional sentence (unfulfilled past condition), the 'if' clause uses Past Perfect ('had invited'), and the main clause uses 'would have' + V3 ('would have attended').
explanation.hi: Third Conditional वाक्य में (अपूर्ण भूतकाल की शर्त), 'if' उपवाक्य Past Perfect ('had invited') का उपयोग करता है, और मुख्य उपवाक्य 'would have' + V3 ('would have attended') का उपयोग करता है।

question.en: Select the correct sentence that correctly uses the sequence of tenses in reported speech with a universal truth.
question.hi: सार्वभौमिक सत्य के साथ रिपोर्टेड स्पीच में काल के क्रम (sequence of tenses) का सही उपयोग करने वाले वाक्य का चयन करें।

text.en: The teacher said that the earth revolved around the sun.
text.hi: The teacher said that the earth revolved around the sun.

text.en: The teacher said that the earth revolves around the sun.
text.hi: The teacher said that the earth revolves around the sun.

text.en: The teacher said that the earth had revolved around the sun.
text.hi: The teacher said that the earth had revolved around the sun.

text.en: The teacher told that the earth is revolving around the sun.
text.hi: The teacher told that the earth is revolving around the sun.

explanation.en: An exception to the rule of sequence of tenses is that if the reported speech expresses a universal truth or habitual fact, its tense does not change even if the reporting verb is in the past tense.
explanation.hi: काल के क्रम के नियम का अपवाद यह है कि यदि रिपोर्टेड स्पीच में सार्वभौमिक सत्य या आदत संबंधी तथ्य व्यक्त किया गया हो, तो रिपोर्टिंग वर्ब भूतकाल में होने पर भी उसका काल नहीं बदलता है।

question.en: Choose the appropriate tense form to fill in the blank: 'He talks as if he _____ everything about the matter.'
question.hi: रिक्त स्थान भरने के लिए उपयुक्त काल रूप चुनें: 'He talks as if he _____ everything about the matter.'

explanation.en: After 'as if' or 'as though', when expressing an unreal or hypothetical situation in the present, the Simple Past Tense ('knew') is used.
explanation.hi: 'as if' या 'as though' के बाद वर्तमान में अवास्तविक या काल्पनिक स्थिति व्यक्त करने के लिए Simple Past Tense ('knew') का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

question.en: Identify the sentence that correctly exemplifies the Future Perfect Continuous Tense.
question.hi: Future Perfect Continuous Tense का सही उदाहरण देने वाले वाक्य को पहचानिए।

text.en: By next year, I will live here for five years.
text.hi: By next year, I will live here for five years.

text.en: By next year, I will have been living here for five years.
text.hi: By next year, I will have been living here for five years.

text.en: By next year, I will be living here for five years.
text.hi: By next year, I will be living here for five years.

text.en: By next year, I had lived here for five years.
text.hi: By next year, I had lived here for five years.

explanation.en: Future Perfect Continuous Tense uses 'will have been / shall have been' + V1-ing along with a time marker ('By next year... for five years').
explanation.hi: Future Perfect Continuous Tense में समय सूचक ('By next year... for five years') के साथ 'will have been / shall have been' + V1-ing का उपयोग होता है।

question.en: Choose the correct option: 'It is time we _____ our plan.'
question.hi: सही विकल्प चुनें: 'It is time we _____ our plan.'

explanation.en: When 'It is time' or 'It is high time' is followed directly by a subject ('we'), the verb must be in its Simple Past form ('executed').
explanation.hi: जब 'It is time' या 'It is high time' के तुरंत बाद कोई कर्ता ('we') आता है, तो क्रिया अपने Simple Past रूप ('executed') में होनी चाहिए।

question.en: Select the correct structure for a Second Conditional sentence.
question.hi: Second Conditional वाक्य के लिए सही संरचना का चयन करें।

text.en: If I saw him, I will tell him.
text.hi: If I saw him, I will tell him.

text.en: If I see him, I would tell him.
text.hi: If I see him, I would tell him.

text.en: If I saw him, I would tell him.
text.hi: If I saw him, I would tell him.

text.en: If I had seen him, I will tell him.
text.hi: If I had seen him, I will tell him.

explanation.en: In a Second Conditional sentence (hypothetical present/future), the 'if' clause uses Simple Past ('saw'), and the main clause uses 'would' + base verb ('would tell').
explanation.hi: Second Conditional वाक्य (काल्पनिक वर्तमान/भविष्य) में, 'if' उपवाक्य Simple Past ('saw') का उपयोग करता है, और मुख्य उपवाक्य 'would' + मूल क्रिया ('would tell') का उपयोग करता है।

question.en: Which of the following sentences correctly portrays a habitual action in the past?
question.hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा वाक्य भूतकाल में किसी आदत संबंधी कार्य को सही ढंग से चित्रित करता है?

text.en: He is going to the temple daily last year.
text.hi: He is going to the temple daily last year.

text.en: He would go to the temple daily when he lived in Varanasi.
text.hi: He would go to the temple daily when he lived in Varanasi.

text.en: He has gone to the temple daily last year.
text.hi: He has gone to the temple daily last year.

text.en: He goes to the temple daily last year.
text.hi: He goes to the temple daily last year.

explanation.en: 'Would' or 'used to' is used to express past habits. The clause 'when he lived in Varanasi' sets a past time frame, making 'would go' appropriate.
explanation.hi: भूतकाल की आदतों को व्यक्त करने के लिए 'would' या 'used to' का प्रयोग किया जाता है। 'when he lived in Varanasi' उपवाक्य भूतकाल का समय निर्धारित करता है, जिससे 'would go' उपयुक्त बनता है।

question.en: Fill in the blank with the correct tense form: 'By the time the chief guest arrived, the function _____.'
question.hi: सही काल रूप से रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'By the time the chief guest arrived, the function _____.'

explanation.en: When an action in the past ('arrived' - Simple Past) occurred after another past action was already completed, the earlier completed action takes the Past Perfect Tense ('had started').
explanation.hi: जब भूतकाल की कोई घटना ('arrived' - Simple Past) किसी अन्य भूतकालीन कार्य के पहले ही पूरा हो जाने के बाद घटी हो, तो पहले पूरे हुए कार्य के लिए Past Perfect Tense ('had started') का प्रयोग होता है।
